warnings: The published table title says 2010–2025; inpatient series also contain 2005–2009 columns. Both the title and actual column years are preserved.
The same 2024/2025 values also occur in policy observations; these views share a source and must not be concatenated as independent measurements.
Reported mean stay does not always equal patient-days/admissions; retain reported measures until the publisher clarifies definitions.
Occupancy in 2023/2024 is published as na; missing is not zero.
This institutional series cannot establish available appointments or assign utilization to residents, origins or a separate hospital campus.
